title: Valid palindrome (alphanumeric, case-insensitive)
source: LeetCode #125 Valid Palindrome — canonical string normalization + reverse/two-pointer; ubiquitous in coding screens.
prompt: Write a JavaScript function `isPalindrome(s)` that returns true if the string is a palindrome when considering only alphanumeric characters and ignoring case, and false otherwise. An empty string (or a string with no alphanumeric characters) is a palindrome.

args: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
Was it a car or a cat I saw?
